signals.usability_note: Clear view of a two-story white colonial house with dark shutters across a cul-de-sac. The house is set back and partly screened by trees, but the frontage is visible.

provider_truck.evidence: No commercial work vehicles are visible at the property.

professional_landscaping.evidence: The lawn is neatly mowed and there are small shrub beds near the house, but nothing shows crew-level work.

solar_panels.evidence: The visible roof planes show no panels.

signals.notes: Colonial home on a cul-de-sac lot with a long asphalt driveway curving to the left, mature trees around it, and a fire hydrant at the curb.
